findings.summary: The 52 vault CCs only ran manually during SDDK cycles; a regression in vault files would not be caught until the next drift sweep

subject.gap: Vault files (.sddk-knowledge/.../vault-drift-sweep.md, cycles/index.md, change-entry.md, archive-manifest.md, cycle-artifacts/*) had no CI automation. Drift was only detected when an SDDK cycle ran a manual sweep.
subject.fix: CI workflow .github/workflows/vault-drift.yml executes scripts/check_vault_drift.sh on every push to main and every PR that touches vault files. The script runs CC#48 meta-check (which executes every other CC) and exits 1 on drift.

lens_summary: m9-64 closes the gap where vault CCs only ran manually. Single-commit B-direct: 1 workflow file + 1 shell script. No source code changes. Self-tested with synthetic m9-99 drift injection: script correctly returns exit 1 + DRIFT report.
